newsitem.title: USA: Allegheny Ludlum sets stainless investment.
newsitem.headline: Allegheny Ludlum sets stainless investment.

text.p: Allegheny Ludlum, an Allegheny Teledyne Inc unit, said Monday it will spend about $40 million for a new Sendzimir mill to improve the cost-effectiveness of its stainless steel finishing operations.

"Our powerful new Z-mill will be equipped with advanced process control systems for improving quality and reducing cost," said Allegheny Ludlum. "We will study possible finished widths of up to 60 inches. The new mill is expected to be in operation by early 1999."
